summary: the side of a cubic box for a number of particles of a given volume at a given volume fraction

inputs.name: particle_count
inputs.meaning: how many particles the box holds

inputs.name: particle_volume
inputs.meaning: the volume of one particle, in the engine's own units

inputs.name: volume_fraction
inputs.meaning: the fraction of the box the particles fill, above zero and below one

outputs.name: box_length
outputs.meaning: the side of the cubic box

outputs.name: box_volume
outputs.meaning: the box's volume, particle_count times particle_volume over volume_fraction

validity: identical particles in a cubic box; the volume fraction above zero and below one

source.citation: by definition: the volume fraction is the particles' total volume over the box's volume
source.locus: the definition of the volume fraction of a suspension or a packing
